context_requirements: Cells must have an active sterol regulatory element-binding protein (SREBP) pathway to mount the compensatory transcriptional response.
Cells must express CYP51A1 and depend on de novo sterol synthesis for membrane and lipid homeostasis.
The drug must engage CYP51A1 at 10 micromolar; cells with high efflux or low intracellular accumulation may show weak responses.
falsifiers: No increase in SREBP target genes such as HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, or INSIG1 at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line.
A decrease rather than an increase in SREBP target genes after treatment.
No change in any landmark gene across all nine cell lines at both time points.
A strong generic stress or apoptosis signature without the expected sterol-pathway transcriptional response.
